notes: Hand-picked for a trip to the Canary Islands (Tenerife, Gran Canaria, Fuerteventura, La Palma and the ferry crossings). The Spain trip holds the mainland birds; this pack adds the island endemics and specialities: the two blue chaffinches, Bolle's and Laurel Pigeon, Canary Islands Chiffchaff, Fuerteventura Stonechat, Berthelot's Pipit, Atlantic Canary, African Blue Tit, Plain Swift, Barbary Partridge, African Houbara and Laughing Dove, plus the shearwaters, storm-petrel and Red-billed Tropicbird seen on ferries and pelagics.
